text:
maya: Quick check-in — we need greenlight owners for the final launch gate. Please confirm: SLA doc, monitoring alerts, rollout policy, docs, pricing table, and oncall roster.
sam: SLA ready for review. Targets: 99.9% uptime, p95 <120ms, p99 <350ms. SLA credit calc in pricing sheet.
devin: p99 tail concerns for long-context. Proposal: auto-fallback to slim-model after 420ms, with a burn-rate alert if error budget >10% over 1h. I will own monitoring.
maya: Assigning devin as monitoring owner. Include exact alert names and Slack runbook steps.
alex: Pricing proposal: Starter / Pro / Enterprise. Starter = low QPS + token cap; Pro = higher QPS + burst; Enterprise = reserved capacity + credits. Ill finalize the table and post link.
liz: Docs owner: will publish quickstart, SDK + curl snippets, troubleshooting matrix, and rollback steps. ETA EOD.
ben: Oncall: primary + secondary for first 2 weeks, then normal rotation. Need finalized roster names T-24h.
sam: Rollout plan: micro-canary 1% first 3h, 5% next 12h, 25% after 48h. Auto-rollback on error-rate >2% sustained 15m or latency SLO breach.
devin: Add synthetic prompts for quality regression detection; hook eval alerts to #eng-ml.
maya: Customer comms owner? Need short template + FAQ on pricing/overages.
alex: Sales will drive customer comms; Ill draft a short FAQ and coordinate with AEs.
liz: Docs will include a customer-facing "what to expect" about cold starts and quantization artifacts.
ben: Risk: reserved-capacity sizing. Sales must collect minimum commit numbers. Alex, can you lead?
alex: Yup, sales + product will define minimums.
maya: Final signoff checklist for T-12h: SLA doc link, runbook, alert defs, smoke results, docs published, pricing table locked, oncall roster, commit collection. I will circulate the one-line signoff form.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1755600000 (T-24h) to collect final signoffs.
sam: Smoke tests scheduled tonight; small chaos run tomorrow AM. Will post results here.
devin: Smoke started — reporting back in 25m.
liz: Draft docs link posted in thread when ready.
maya: Thanks all — aiming to close owners by T-12h. :thumbsup:
